mapper.select: SELECT `tenant` FROM `alarm_record` GROUP BY `tenant`

UPDATE `alarm_record` ar INNER JOIN `alarm_record_handler_user` arhu on ar.`id` = arhu.`alarm_record_id` SET ar.`alarm_handler_result` = 'ALARM_IMPRACTICAL', ar.`alarm_status` = 'ALARM_HANDLER', ar.`alarm_status_order` = 2, ar.`alarm_handler_by` = #{userId}, ar.`alarm_handler_name` = #{userName}, ar.`alarm_handler_time` = #{handlerDate} WHERE arhu.`user_id` = #{userId} AND ar.`alarm_status` != 'ALARM_HANDLER' AND ar.`id` in
#{id}

SELECT COUNT(t2.`id`) as `alarm_count` FROM `alarm_record` t1 INNER JOIN `alarm_record_target` t2 ON t1.`id` = t2.`alarm_record_id` where t2.`user_id` = #{userId} AND t1.`alarm_status` != 'ALARM_HANDLER'

SELECT t1.`id`, t1.`alarm_target_name`, t1.`area_name`, t1.`alarm_event_name`, t1.`alarm_time`, t1.`application_code`, t1.`application_name`, t2.`user_id` FROM `alarm_record` t1 INNER JOIN `alarm_record_handler_user` t2 on t1.`id` = t2.`alarm_record_id` WHERE t1.`alarm_status` != 'ALARM_HANDLER' and t1.`application_code` = #{applicationCode} AND t1.`timeout_equipped` = 1 AND t1.`timeout_process_time` >= #{beginDate} AND t1.`timeout_process_time` <= #{endDate}

SELECT ar.`id`, ar.`code`, ar.`alarm_level_id`, ar.`alarm_level_code`, ar.`alarm_level_name`, ar.`alarm_level_sort`, ar.`alarm_type_id`, ar.`alarm_type_code`, ar.`alarm_type_name`, ar.`alarm_type_file_id`, ar.`alarm_target_key`, ar.`alarm_target_code`, ar.`alarm_target_name`, ar.`alarm_target_type_id`, ar.`alarm_target_type_name`, ar.`alarm_target_longitude`, ar.`business_type`, ar.`business_key`, ar.`alarm_time`, ar.`area`, ar.`area_name`, ar.`alarm_threshold`, ar.`alarm_event`, ar.`alarm_event_name`, ar.`alarm_event_type_id`, ar.`alarm_event_type_code`, ar.`alarm_event_type_name`, ar.`alarm_status`, ar.`alarm_confirmed_by`, ar.`alarm_confirmed_name`, ar.`alarm_confirmed_time`, ar.`estimate_handler_time`, ar.`alarm_handler_by`, ar.`alarm_handler_time`, ar.`alarm_handler_result`, ar.`alarm_handler_result_remark`, ar.`timeout_equipped`, ar.`timeout_process_time`, ar.`timeout_process_times`, ar.`timeout_process_times_unit`, ar.`application_id`, ar.`filter_scope`, ar.`application_code`, ar.`application_name` FROM `alarm_record` ar WHERE ar.`alarm_status` = 'ALARM_UN_CONFIRMED' AND ar.`create_time` >= #{beginDate} AND ar.`create_time` <= #{endDate}

SELECT ar.`id`, ar.`code`, ar.`alarm_level_id`, ar.`alarm_level_code`, ar.`alarm_level_name`, ar.`alarm_level_sort`, ar.`alarm_type_id`, ar.`alarm_type_code`, ar.`alarm_type_name`, ar.`alarm_type_file_id`, ar.`alarm_target_key`, ar.`alarm_target_code`, ar.`alarm_target_name`, ar.`alarm_target_type_id`, ar.`alarm_target_type_name`, ar.`alarm_target_longitude`, ar.`business_type`, ar.`business_key`, ar.`alarm_time`, ar.`area`, ar.`area_name`, ar.`alarm_threshold`, ar.`alarm_event`, ar.`alarm_event_name`, ar.`alarm_event_type_id`, ar.`alarm_event_type_code`, ar.`alarm_event_type_name`, ar.`alarm_status`, ar.`alarm_confirmed_by`, ar.`alarm_confirmed_name`, ar.`alarm_confirmed_time`, ar.`estimate_handler_time`, ar.`alarm_handler_by`, ar.`alarm_handler_time`, ar.`alarm_handler_result`, ar.`alarm_handler_result_remark`, ar.`timeout_equipped`, ar.`timeout_process_time`, ar.`timeout_process_times`, ar.`timeout_process_times_unit`, ar.`filter_scope`, ar.`application_id`, ar.`application_code`, ar.`application_name` FROM `alarm_record` ar WHERE ar.`alarm_status` != 'ALARM_HANDLER' AND ar.`timeout_equipped` = 1 AND ar.`timeout_process_time` >= #{beginDate} AND ar.`timeout_process_time` <= #{endDate}
SELECT `application_code` FROM `alarm_record` GROUP BY `application_code`
mapper.sql: COUNT(1) as `total_num`, COALESCE (SUM(if(`alarm_status` = 'ALARM_UN_CONFIRMED',1,0)),0) as `unconfirmed_num`, COALESCE (SUM(if(`alarm_status` = 'ALARM_PROGRESS_CONFIRMED',1,0)),0) as `progress_confirmed_num`, COALESCE (SUM(if(`alarm_status` = 'ALARM_SUSPEND',1,0)),0) as `suspend_num`, COALESCE (SUM(if(`alarm_status` = 'ALARM_HANDLER',1,0)),0) as `handler_num`, COALESCE ( SUM( IF ( `alarm_status` != 'ALARM_HANDLER' AND `timeout_process_time` <= NOW() or `alarm_status` = 'ALARM_HANDLER' AND `timeout_process_time` <= `alarm_handler_time`, 1, 0 )), 0 ) AS `timeout_num`, COALESCE (SUM(if(`alarm_handler_result` = 'ALARM_ACTUAL',1,0)),0) as `alarm_actual_num`, COALESCE (SUM(if(`alarm_handler_result` = 'ALARM_IMPRACTICAL',1,0)),0) as `alarm_impractical_num`, COALESCE (SUM(ar.`processing_time`),0) as `processing_time`

SELECT ar.`alarm_event_type_name` AS `alarm_event_name`, ar.`alarm_event_type_code` as `alarm_event_type_id`,
FROM `alarm_record` ar
GROUP BY ar.`alarm_event_type_name`, ar.`alarm_event_type_code` ORDER BY COUNT( 1 ) DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) as `total_num` FROM `alarm_record` ar

SELECT temp1.`department_id`,
FROM `alarm_record` ar INNER JOIN ( SELECT arhu.`department_id`, arhu.`alarm_record_id`, arhu.`department_name` FROM `alarm_record_handler_user` arhu GROUP BY arhu.`department_id`, arhu.`alarm_record_id` ) temp1 ON temp1.`alarm_record_id` = ar.`id`
GROUP BY temp1.`department_id` ORDER BY COUNT( 1 ) DESC
